_comment: Files from the Unofficial MusicXML test suite (Reinhold Kainhofer; cuthbertLab fork, MIT, see LICENSE) that tools/run_musicxml.py does not expect to engrave cleanly, and why. A "defect" entry must still fail; its passing is an error. See that tool's docstring for the format.

24c-GraceNote-MeasureEnd.xml.note: LilyPond's own defect, issue 2383 (https://gitlab.com/lilypond/lilypond/-/work_items/2383), on 2.24 and 2.26: at the staff-space 7/4 that cnb:default-magnify sets, an up-stem 16th grace beam above the staff gets no viable quant, so LilyPond engraves its unquanted fallback beam

61g-Lyrics-NameNumber.xml.defect: musicxml2ly 2.24 crashes: 'ValueError: No closing quotation' in shlex; 2.26's converts it

61k-Lyrics-SpannersExtenders.xml.defect: musicxml2ly 2.24 crashes: 'ValueError: No closing quotation' in shlex; 2.26's converts it
